items.title: Would this work for hands free?
items.content: <!-- SC_OFF --><div class="md"><p>I am thinking about getting gear for hands free set up<br/> For Handy 1. </p> <p>Option A: cup connector and official desk mount, together is ludicrously expensive, the mount alone is $52!</p> <p>Option B: cup connector and third party clam such as this one, which someone here recommended:</p> <p><a href="https://a.co/d/06Zz6eeF">https://a.co/d/06Zz6eeF</a></p> <p>The main drawback is the second clamp looks kind of small and shallow and I want something that clamps on to desk….robustly. </p> <p>Not interested in any crazy setups and I don’t have a 3D printer to make parts. Should I bite the bullet and just get the official stuff? Or maybe there is another product someone could recommend?</p> <p>Thanks</p> </div><!-- SC_ON --> &#32; submitted by &#32; <a href="https://www.reddit.com/user/distaltoss"> /u/distaltoss </a> <br/> <span><a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/theHandy/comments/1vfvkco/would_this_work_for_hands_free/">[link]</a></span&g
